    | inl val_l =>

            exists t₁.app t₂'
            grind
    | inr red_l =>

        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>

    specialize ih rfl der

  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, t₁, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        exact ⟨_, .abs val_l.lc val_r⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp t₁ σ τ σ' der sub ih =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, t, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨_, .tabs val.lc (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc red⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih _ =>
    right
    have b₂ : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    rcases ih rfl with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body val b₂⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind red b₂⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · exact .inl (.inl val)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inl red⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · exact .inl (.inr val)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inr red⟩
  case case t₁ σ τ t₂ t₃ δ L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have b₂ : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₂ x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    have b₃ : t₃.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₃ x hx).wf.2.1⟩

  case sub _ _ ih => exact ih rfl
  case abs σ t₁ τ L h _ =>
